home.headline: Architecture of record.
home.standfirst: KA Global Architects designs residential, administrative and industrial buildings of any complexity. More than 18 years, 80 specialists, 15 jobs in progress and 120+ completed projects.
home.drawingNote: Original massing and site diagrams. Photographs of completed buildings are not presented as studio photography.
home.practiceBody: Concept, draft and working project, SNiP and Eurocodes, BIM/Revit/VR, construction supervision. Director Okan Yeşilgöz — 24 years in construction and design.
home.constructionBody: KA Global Construction handles building, repair and fit-out. The Shell offices in Almaty and Aktau were delivered by this arm.
home.briefTitle: A new plot, a reconstruction or a working project — write to the studio.
home.osTitle: Live line and the Gosexpertiza gate.
home.osBody: Concept, architectural sketch, working project, documentation, state expertise. The HALAVET gate is closed today.

projects.heading: Studio files

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: GIP, architecture, structures, MEP, BIM, documentation, expertise.
departments.heading: Departments
departments.intro: Every volume has an owner department. Only the expertise agent and expertise_gate open the gate.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: KA Global GIP desk and department agents: concept through Gosexpertiza.
agents.heading: Agents
agents.intro: The parent agent is the GIP desk. Architecture, structures, MEP, documentation and expertise are delegated.
agents.validateHint: Run from global-architects-agent: validate, tool call expertise_gate, then dev. Do not attach it to the FISTIK bakery repo.

playbook.title: Playbook
playbook.description: Concept → sketch → working project → documentation → Gosexpertiza gate.
playbook.heading: Playbook
playbook.intro: Do not skip a stage. A handsome 3D is not an expertise package.
playbook.gateTitle: Only the gate tells the truth.
playbook.gateNote: If required codes are not ready or approved, do not file. The authority issues the conclusion, not the agent.
playbook.githubBody: The drawing tree never mixes with the FISTIK bakery app. Git tracks the register; PDFs and DWGs live in LFS or object storage.

practice.title: Practice
practice.description: KA Global Architects — I-category design firm in Almaty.
practice.heading: Practice in Almaty
practice.intro: We design buildings of any purpose and complexity. Kazakhstan Hotel, 52/2 Dostyk Ave., office 605.
practice.body1: An I-category license covers work of any complexity: logistics yards in Tuymebaev, oncology clinics, mixed-use residential complexes.
practice.body2: The practice covers architecture, structure, engineering, interiors, masterplanning, BIM/Revit/VR and 3D visualization of facades and interiors.
practice.body3: KA Global Construction closes building, repair and fit-out — including the Shell offices.
practice.construction: Building, repair, fit-out. Shell Almaty office (2016, 3,200 m²) and the subsequent Aktau office.
practice.m1Body: SNiP, Eurocodes, packages for state expertise. Positive conclusions include Four Seasons, UNION, Borusan, LC Waikiki.
practice.m2Body: Revit and BIM for discipline coordination; VR review of massing before client approval.
practice.m3Body: Construction supervision and coordination of working-project changes during building.

brief.pageDescription: TZ brief for a new plot. A structured WhatsApp message.
brief.pageIntro: The GIP desk starts here. Client, site, typology, approximate area — then sketch.
